Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won't be customer-facing, but you'll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You'll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You'll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.Work with AI agents. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0You don't need to be a data engineer, but you'll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure ADCI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You'll own the path from merged PR to running in production.What they're looking for:Must-havesAI engineering experience. You've built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.Js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.Production shipping muscle. You've taken something from "it works on my machine" to "it's running in production with real users." CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say "this seems wrong" when it does. No yes-people.AI agent systems experience. You've built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents;
you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.Nice-to-haves:Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analyticsSnowflake / SQL analytics experienceExperience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UXAzure cloud platform experienceLLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptimeHow our partner works:Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn't optional it's how they ship quality at speed with a small team.Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say "not yet available," not fake numbers.Documentation as code. CLAUDE.Md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.Benefits:A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.Two weeks of paid vacation per year.10 paid days for local holidays.*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas. Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua. Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI. Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares. #SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Server Manager (Global Project) Inglês Avançado
description: Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem. Você fará parte de um projeto global, integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais. Principais Responsabilidades Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema: Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho. Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração. Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes. Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede. Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos. Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua. Requisitos Técnicos Centrais Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema. Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis. Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP. Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial. Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade. Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF. Qualificações e Experiência Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores. Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas. Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês. Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa. Imporante: Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Revley Payments Engineer — Stripe Connect / White-Label Payments Platform
description: Company DescriptionRevley is the commerce operating system for the next generation of subscription brands. Headquartered in Manhattan. Bootstrapped. Profitable.We exist because the modern commerce stack is broken. Brands stitch together a checkout from one vendor, a subscription engine from another, a payment processor from a third, a chargeback tool from a fourth — and spend more time managing the seams than growing. We replace all of it. One platform. Payments, subscriptions, checkout, tokenization, analytics, and revenue protection — unified, owned by the merchant, portable across every processor.Our largest merchant processes $20M/month. In 8 months we've signed enterprise contracts with 12 partners including Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex, Nuvei, NMI, Finix, Braintree, and Authorize.Net. Brands using Revley don't rent their payment infrastructure. They own it.We move fast, ship daily, and treat every merchant relationship like the one that defines the company. If you've ever looked at the commerce stack and thought this should be one thing, not ten — you already understand Revley.Role DescriptionThis is a full-time remote role for a Payments Engineer specializing in Stripe Connect and white-label payments platforms at Revley. title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: Sr. Ai Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)Please upload your CV Resume in English.Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USDAlong with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.The role:They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.What you’ll do:Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.Tech you’ll work with:Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.Js, ReactMonorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure ADCI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.What they’re looking for:Must-havesAI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.Js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents;
you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.Nice-to-haves:Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analyticsSnowflake / SQL analytics experienceExperience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UXAzure cloud platform experienceLLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptimeHow our partner works:Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.Documentation as code. CLAUDE.Md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.Benefits:A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.Two weeks of paid vacation per year.10 paid days for local holidays.*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Scripting Power Query M Formatação dinâmica Recursos otimizados da faixa de opções Relatórios paginados Colaborar com equipes de engenharia para integrar soluções do Power BI Gerenciar o controle de versão usando o GitHub, incluindo: Controle de código-fonte para projetos PBIP Ramificações, pull requests e revisões de código Fluxos de trabalho alinhados com os pipelines de implantação do Power BI no GitHub Realizar otimização de desempenho para grandes conjuntos de dados utilizando técnicas como: Agregações Modelos compostos Ajuste de desempenho do DAX Estabelecer parceria com as partes interessadas da empresa para compreender as necessidades de relatórios e traduzi-las em soluções analíticas escaláveis. Excelente compreensão dos conceitos de modelagem de dados (star schema, fact/dimension design, normalization). Sólida experiência em Power BI Desktop e Power BI Service, incluindo recursos modernos Capacidade comprovada de criar e otimizar modelos de dados e escrever código DAX eficiente. Experiência no uso do GitHub para controle de versão com arquivos PBIP do Power BI. Sólidos conhecimentos de SQL e experiência em trabalhar com fontes de dados corporativas Capacidade de colaborar em equipes ágeis e multifuncionais. Inglês avançado para conversação. Experiência com análises em escala corporativa, grandes conjuntos de dados e técnicas de ajuste de desempenho. title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). title: Estagiário Comercial
description: A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados. Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental. Requisitos e qualificações: ●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia. ●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região. ●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal. ●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) Inglês Avançado
description: Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem. Você fará parte de um projeto global, integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais. Principais Responsabilidades Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema: Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho. Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração. Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes. Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede. Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos. Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua. Requisitos Técnicos Centrais Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema. Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis. Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP. Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial. Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade. Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF. Qualificações e Experiência Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores. Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas. Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês. Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa. Imporante: Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Financial Reporting Analyst
description: Financial Reporting Analyst Location: Remote (Brazil) About Sphise Technologies Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Financial Reporting Analyst tto support financial reporting, analysis, and data-driven decision-making, ensuring accuracy, visibility, and actionable insights across the business. Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Sap Basis
description: Make this the place where you grow! Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas. Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT. Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Expert com sólida experiência em projetos complexos de upgrade, conversão e migração de ambientes SAP. Você atuará em um contexto global, liderando execuções técnicas críticas, garantindo estabilidade, performance e evolução de ambientes SAP, colaborando com times multiculturais e clientes internacionais. Principais Responsabilidades: Liderar tecnicamente projetos de upgrades, conversões, migrações e manutenções em ambientes SAP. Planejar e executar estratégias completas de evolução de sistemas: análise de impacto, roadmap técnico, cronogramas e execução em ambientes Dev/QA/Prod. Conduzir processos de system upgrade, system conversion, OS/DB migration, e HANA upgrades, assegurando conformidade com melhores práticas SAP. Realizar cutover planning, coordenação de mock runs e atividades críticas de produção. Diagnosticar incidentes complexos em ambientes SAP Basis, atuando na resolução de problemas e mitigação de riscos. Garantir documentação completa dos processos técnicos, lições aprendidas e recomendações de melhoria contínua. Colaborar com equipes funcionais, arquitetos e stakeholders globais para assegurar compatibilidade e readiness das soluções. Acompanhar o roadmap SAP, avaliando impactos e oportunidades de atualização para os ambientes dos clientes. Requisitos: 8+ anos de experiência comprovada em SAP Basis. Domínio em: SAP system upgrades (NetWeaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) SAP S/4HANA conversions (pré-checks, simplification item, custom code remediation) System copies e client copies OS/DB migrations e Unicode conversions HANA database upgrades Proficiência com ferramentas: SUM, DMO, Maintenance Planner, SPAM/SAINT. Inglês avançado para comunicação com equipes e clientes internacionais. Experiência em ambientes globais ou operações Nearshore é um diferencial. Diferenciais: Certificações SAP Basis ou SAP HANA. Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Vivência com projetos multiculturais. Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT Modalidade: 100% Home office Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance. *Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment. Monitor performance, capacity, cost, and proactively resolve risks. Execute changes through change management with minimal disruption. Support hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS). Participate in on‑call rotation and lead post‑incident reviews. Maintain documentation, runbooks, and automate tasks with scripting. Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps workflows for stability, patching, backup, and DR. Employment Type: (Permanent) What do we offer?
